debit.sms: LOST <space> <last 4 digits of your card number> (e.g.: LOST 1234) or LOST <space> <complete 14 digits account number> — send to 8828554038 from your registered mobile number for permanent blocking (hotlist); temporary block/unblock: TBLOCK <last 4 digits> / UBLOCK <last 4 digits> to 8828554038.
debit.notes: The Card Block/Hotlisting page: for permanent blocking (lost/stolen) of an ATM/Debit card, SMS 'LOST <last 4 digits of card>' or 'LOST <14-digit account number>' to 8828554038 from the registered mobile number, or call 1800-419-8300, or use PSB UnIC Mobile or Internet Banking, or contact any PSB branch; temporary block/unblock via TBLOCK/UBLOCK SMS or PSB UnIC/branch. The customer-care page is titled 'PSB Customer Care - 24x7 Helpline & Support' and the footer marks the NRI overseas line 'Call Centre 24*7'. NRI lines: 1800 569 5577 toll-free (within India, NRI customers only) and 011-25788401 +91-2245899049 (outside India only). A WhatsApp number +91 77999 62838 sits beside the toll-free in the sitewide header. No app menu path for blocking is published — pages only say 'PSB UnIC Mobile or Internet Banking'; the homepage's 'Download PSB UnIC app' Google Play button targets the 'PSB UnIC Biz' listing (com.psb.omnicorporate) and the App Store button the PSB UnIC app. The Contact Us page publishes the HO customer-excellence email (shown obfuscated as ho[dot]customerexcellence[at]psb[dot]co[dot]in) — no dedicated card-block email is published. The footer also publishes 'In Case of Cyber Fraud Debit Freeze Your Account: 5616118'. The bank's site now lives at punjabandsind.bank.in; the former punjabandsindbank.co.in no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN on Google and Cloudflare DoH).

credit.notes: No credit-card blocking channel is published on the bank's own pages. Punjab & Sind Bank's credit cards are the 'PSB SBI Co-branded Credit Card' (PRIME/ELITE); its credit-cards page lists only fees and rewards — no block instructions, no credit-card helpline and no SBI Card contact — while the Card Block/Hotlisting page and the Contact page's hot-listing entry cover only ATM/Debit (RuPay) cards. The old entry's credit numbers (1800-227-034, 011-2718-0000) and email customercare@punjabandsindbank.co.in appear nowhere on the current official site; the all-India toll-free 1800-419-8300 listed under debit is the bank's published customer-care line, but no official page states it as a credit-card block channel.

upi.notes: UPI runs through the bank's 'PSB UNIC BHIM App' (UPI page, titled 'UPI | Instant & Secure Digital Payment System'; VPAs like 'choice@psb or choice@psbpay') and its published features include 'User can also block VPA and report SPAM too.' — the only UPI-blocking capability the bank publishes. The bank-hosted 'PSB UnIC- UPI FAQs' PDF gives the full withdrawal path: 'How can I de-register from UPI App?' → 'Please Login into App. Choose Others --> De-register.'; for a lost phone it advises only 'get your mobile number blocked through your service provider' (the app PIN protects logins/transactions); disputes go via 'Menu --> profile --> log a dispute'; and to 'Can I get your Customer Care Number…' it answers 'You may call on our Toll Free number 1800 419 8300.' The homepage's 'Download PSB UnIC app' buttons link the App Store listing psb-unic (id1597657276) and the Google Play listing com.psb.omnicorporate — that Play listing is currently titled 'PSB UnIC Biz - Apps on Google Play' (the retail registration doc says 'Download Punjab and Sind Bank PSB UnIC app from google play store'). No in-app UPI transactions on/off lock, no netbanking UPI manage/disable path, no UPI SMS keyword and no *99# USSD reference is published on the bank's own pages (the IMPS/USSD page carries no *99# content).
